records.title: Banach NAWA Scholarship Programme
records.official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA) / Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
records.deadline_display: Announcement of a call for applications No. 16/2026 of 13 April 2026, for studies or preparatory course from the winter semester 2026/27. The exact closing date is published inside the call PDF and could not be read.
records.application_period: One call per academic year. For the winter semester 2026/27 intake the call was announced on 13 April 2026 (No. 16/2026) and has already closed; the next annual call is expected in spring 2027 for the 2027/28 winter semester.

records.title: Poland My First Choice NAWA
records.official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
records.application_period: One call per academic year, published on NAWA's Poland My First Choice programme page. The stored call-for-applications URL for this programme returns HTTP 404 on 2026-10-04, so no current deadline could be read.

records.title: Aotearoa New Zealand Tāwhia te Mana Research Fellowships — New Zealand Mana Tūāpapa Future Leader Fellowship
records.deadline_display: For the 2026 round the on-line portal opened Friday 1 May 2026 and closed at 2.00pm NZST on Thursday 9 July 2026; the Society has not published the opening or closing dates for the next round.
records.application_period: Annual funding round. 2026 round: 1 May 2026 to 2.00pm NZST, 9 July 2026; results announced late October 2026. Next round dates not yet published.

records.title: Poland My First Choice NAWA Programme
records.deadline_display: The 2026 call was published as 'no 19/2026 of 30th April 2026' with results announced by NAWA on 3 August 2026, so that cycle is closed. The submission deadline itself is stated inside the announcement PDF, which was not opened; no deadline date is asserted here. The next call is expected in spring 2027.
records.application_period: Annual call published by NAWA each spring for the following academic year (call no 13/2025 for 2025/26; call no 19/2026 of 30 April 2026 for 2026/27)
